coverage.meaning: A geographic study window containing the atlas core regions. Outside this window the population layer is not shown; unshaded areas there do not indicate absence of people.

sources.title: History Database of the Global Environment, HYDE3.3
sources.author: Kees Klein Goldewijk / Utrecht University
sources.sourceVariable: popc: total inhabitants per source grid cell, urban and rural combined
sources.licence: CC BY3.0 as stated in the supplied HYDE data README
sources.modification: Cropped and aggregated to half-degree study cells; intermediate timeline values are linear interpolations of source counts.
sources.licenceQualification: Repository landing metadata names CC BY4.0; the actual grid README names CC BY3.0. Both original declarations are retained in the research notes.

metadata.populationMeaning: Estimated total human inhabitants, including urban and rural populations; not counts of entered places, rulers or evidence records.
metadata.densityUnit: people per square kilometre of source land area
metadata.areaDefinition: SUM of HYDE maxln_cr.asc source land area within each aggregated cell, matching the published popd denominator.
metadata.gridChoice: Nominal5arcminute global lattice inferred from the documented4320×2160 full-world grid; the printed cellsize is rounded. No historical coordinate accuracy follows.
metadata.interpolation: Linear in source population counts on the HYDE published year axis, between the surrounding source snapshots; no extrapolation.
metadata.calendar: Source0AD is retained as HYDE model-axis0, outside the playable500–3200BCE domain. It is not a claim that a civil historical year zero existed.
metadata.uncertainty: Ancient population totals and their local allocation are uncertain model estimates. This layer uses Baseline only; it supplies no confidence interval.
metadata.display: Fixed absolute density scale at every date. Native coarse cells are visually smoothed and clipped to modern reference land; zoom does not add demographic detail.
metadata.editing: Rebuild with Tools/build_population24.py --rebuild-only from the included lossless regional source crops. Source counts are separate from artistic opacity and palette.
metadata.scopeLimit: The model adds no ethnic, political, archaeological occupation or settlement-boundary claim.
